values.meaning: bonus physical damage on basic attacks from behind
values.binNote: Bin's byLevel(20..35) for ShacoPassive.AttackBonusADRatio's base scales to 35 at level 18, but the wiki's pp formula (20 + (35-25)/17*(x-1)) evaluates to only 30 at level 18; using the wiki's stated formula as required, flagging the disagreement with the bin's stated 20..35 range.

mechanics.claim: Backstab's bonus damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.
mechanics.quote: This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: Backstab's bonus damage adds to the same damage instance as the triggering basic attack rather than being a separate hit.
mechanics.quote: Backstab's bonus damage adds to the damage instance of the original basic attack.

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage does not apply against structures.
mechanics.quote: The attacks do not deal the '''bonus''' damage against {{tip|structures}}.
